common_object_construction.status: Construct proposed common frame from the actual fitted artifact; do not begin by assuming independent layers already have compatible witnesses.
steps: Before actual fitting, fix one complete interpretation object μ=(feature definition/normalization,target definition,supported domain,version); retain that same μ object through fit arguments and outputs.

Construct the fit graph as rawConfirmed observations → encode through that μ to Dμ → existing fit/prepare chain. Only after a known fit, freeze the same μ, actual fit inputs/outputs, full training snapshot, actual model and authenticated use-scope into one immutable Artifact. This constructs common provenance rather than assuming separately supplied layers already have compatible witnesses.

The proposed makeFrame(context, Artifact A, catalog, index, actual_source_view) first verifies that catalog/index resolves exactly to A.actual_model and its authenticated use-scope. Only after that check, construct Checkpoint via existing checkpointFor for this same catalog/index, captured use-scope, derived query and A artifact evidence; do not relabel a model registered for another authenticated use-scope. Fitted snapshot is projected from that model.snapshot; candidate-input snapshot remains a separate journal projection.

The proposed constructor makes Frame O from context, A, catalog/index and actual_source_view; it is not an arbitrary tuple of independent layer witnesses. The context supplies fixed rule/mechanism/Γ, while all model/data/query/CP values below are assigned only by projections. If the catalog/model/use-scope check or any projection fails, return UNKNOWN.

μ is the externally fixed interpretation already declared by the model; its physical truth is not proved by version labels. The constructed internal views share this μ by construction, not by inferring semantics from equal Fin values. If an old artifact has only Nat version/index and cannot resolve complete μ or training-artifact binding, resolve_frame=UNKNOWN; labels cannot recreate compatibility after the fact.
